name: Chat Input
description: Floating capsule input bar: pill-shaped container with send button embedded inside the capsule on the right side, no leading icon, long-press voice input support. Liquid glass aesthetic with soft shadow elevation.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Capsule container with placeholder text, send button hidden when empty

variants.name: Recording
variants.description: Long-press triggered voice recording state: primary@8% background, primary@50% border, placeholder '正在收听…'

states.name: default
states.description: Empty input with placeholder, no send button

states.name: has-text
states.description: Text entered, send button appears inside capsule on the right

states.name: loading
states.description: AI processing, input field disabled, send button hidden

features.description: Long-press (500ms) to start voice recording, swipe up to cancel, release to send
